climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A geographical indication on New Zealand's North Island where white grapes lead. Chardonnay is the main grape at 43% of the vines, followed by Sauvignon Blanc at 26% and Pinot Gris at 21%. Pinot Noir and Merlot are small plantings.
